title: Israel Raids Gaza-Bound Flotilla Near Cyprus, Sparking International Outrage
detail: Israeli forces intercepted and raided a Gaza-bound humanitarian flotilla near Cyprus, drawing sharp international condemnation. The interception — reported by Middle East Eye — is separate from earlier incidents involving flotilla activists already held per UN demands. The raid intensified diplomatic pressure on Israel amid the ongoing siege of Gaza, with activists aboard the vessel detained. The action drew comparisons to the 2010 Mavi Marmara raid and prompted immediate protests across the region.

media.caption: Pro-Palestinian protest in Ankara following Israel's raid on the Gaza-bound flotilla
